subcategories.name: Madd Tabi'i (مَدّ طَبِيعِيّ)
subcategories.description: Natural elongation of alif, waw, or yaa when followed by their corresponding sukun
subcategories.example: قَالَ — elongate the alif for 2 counts

subcategories.name: Madd Lazim (مَدّ لَزِم)
subcategories.description: Forced elongation when a madd letter is followed by a shadda

subcategories.name: Madd Munfasil (مَدّ مُنْفَصِل)
subcategories.description: Elongation when a madd letter is followed by a hamza in a new word
subcategories.example: إِذْ قَالَ — elongate the alif for 2-5 counts

name: Noon Saakin and Tanween (نُون سَاكِنَة وتَنْوِين)
description: Rules for when noon with sukun or tanween appears

subcategories.name: Idgham with Ghunnah (إِدْغَام بِغُنَّة)
subcategories.description: When noon saakin is followed by ي، ر، م، ل، و، ن
subcategories.example: مِنْ يَوْمِ — noon merges into yaa with nasalization

subcategories.name: Idgham without Ghunnah (إِدْغَام بِلَا غُنَّة)
subcategories.description: When noon saakin is followed by ل، ر
subcategories.example: مِن رَّبِّكُم — noon merges into ra without nasalization

subcategories.name: Ikhfa (إِخْفَاء)
subcategories.description: Hidden pronunciation of noon when followed by the remaining 15 letters
subcategories.example: مِن بَعْدِ — noon pronounced with slight concealment

subcategories.name: Izhar (إِظْهَار)
subcategories.description: Clear pronunciation of noon when followed by throat letters

subcategories.name: Ikhfa Shafawi (إِخْفَاء شَفَوِيّ)
subcategories.description: When meem saakin is followed by ب
subcategories.example: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَة — meem merges with slight nasalization

subcategories.name: Idgham Shafawi (إِدْغَام شَفَوِيّ)
subcategories.description: When meem saakin is followed by م
subcategories.example: لَّهُم مَّا — meem merges into following meem

subcategories.name: Izhar Shafawi (إِظْهَار شَفَوِيّ)
subcategories.description: Clear pronunciation of meem when followed by any other letter

name: Qalqalah (قَلْقَلَة)
description: Bouncing vibration of certain letters when they have sukun

subcategories.name: Qalqalah Sughra (قَلْقَلَة صُغْرَى)
subcategories.description: Light qalqalah when the letter has sukun in the middle of a word

subcategories.name: Qalqalah Kubra (قَلْقَلَة كُبْرَى)
subcategories.description: Strong qalqalah when the letter has sukun at the end of a word
subcategories.example: يَا أَيُّهَا — bounce the ه at the end

name: Ghunnah (غُنَّة)
description: Nasalization sound produced through the nose

subcategories.name: Ghunnah with Madd
subcategories.description: Nasalization during elongation of madd letters
subcategories.example: مَن يَمُنُّ — nasalize during the madd

subcategories.name: Ghunnah with Noon Saakin
subcategories.description: Nasalization when noon saakin undergoes idgham with ghunnah
subcategories.example: مِنْ يَوْمِ — nasalize the merged noon

subcategories.name: Jathim (الجَذْم)
subcategories.description: Letters from the tip of the tongue — ت، د، ط، ظ، ن
subcategories.example: ن — tip of tongue touches upper teeth

subcategories.name: Lisan (اللِّسَان)
subcategories.description: Letters from the middle of the tongue — ك، ج، ي
subcategories.example: ك — middle of tongue touches soft palate

subcategories.name: Halq (الحَلْق)
subcategories.description: Letters from the throat — ا، ه، ع، ح، غ، خ
subcategories.letters: ا ه ع ح غ خ
subcategories.example: ع — back of tongue touches throat
